Cylinder positions are measured from the block's own STL, not from guesswork: crank at STL (Y 46.7, Z 14.2), deck 53.2 away, bank tilt 44.6. Block is Z-up (alignment baked in).

System Cut strips the engine in five stages, one at a time - engine block housing, propeller, pistons, crankshaft with its rods, then the heads and ancillaries. At 0 nothing is removed and nothing is sliced: the previous plane cutaway is retired and parked clear of the engine.

Bench model, not the twin. The 3D view is the measured 8-bore casting. The engine the digital twin monitors is a V4 (60° V4 Turbo-Prop), the one shown on the dashboard, telemetry and diagnostics pages. The firing-order row above describes this model's own geometry.
